# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_threshold_detection

Configures threshold detection for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/threshold_detection`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_threshold_detection` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_threshold_detection" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status                 = true
    action                 = "block_period"
    challenge              = "RBE"
    crawler                = false
    vulnerability_scan     = true
    slow_attack            = false
    content_scraping       = false
    credential_brute_force = true
    request_url            = "/login"
    occurrence             = 10
    range                  = 60

    exception_list {
      item {
        concatenate_type = "AND"
        match_target     = "COOKIE"
        operator         = "REGEXP_MATCH"
        value_name       = "session_id"
        value_check      = true
        value            = "terraform-matrix"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- Credential brute-force detection requires `request_url`. Exception IP values must use an address or address range accepted by FortiAppSec Cloud.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed threshold detection configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_threshold_detection` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_threshold_detection.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
